name: Decktopus
tagline: Decktopus is an AI-powered presentation tool that generates complete slide decks from a topic in seconds, including content, visuals, and speaker notes. Its AI tailors presentations to the specific audience and purpose, and includes a form builder for collecting audience feedback directly within slides.
